title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.4-Cyber only to vetted security researchers and agencies
summary: OpenAI released a cybersecurity-tuned model with relaxed guardrails but restricted access to vetted defenders and government agencies because of misuse risk.
reason: Gated release of a dual-use cyber model is a modest control measure; existence of the capability nudges risk.

title: Maine legislature passes first statewide moratorium on large data centers
summary: Maine's House (79-62) and Senate (21-13) passed a bill pausing approvals for data centers over 20 MW until October 2027 while a council studies grid, bill, air and water impacts.
reason: First US state legislature to pass a data-center moratorium is a notable backlash milestone; state-level scope.

title: Novo Nordisk partners with OpenAI, says AI will slow future hiring
summary: Novo Nordisk announced a company-wide OpenAI deployment across drug discovery and operations and said AI would slow future hiring.
reason: Large European employer signalling AI-driven hiring slowdown; words not cuts.

title: CorTec prepares third stroke patient implant of its Brain Interchange BCI
summary: German firm CorTec readied its brain-computer interface for a third stroke patient after early results showed improved hand and arm function.
reason: Incremental BCI clinical progress outside the US.
